Scope of Work: ‘AMC for outsource manpower contract for Colony Housekeeping at Jiri bam Sub-station for a Period of 02 (Two) Years’ as per details, terms and conditions indicat ed in the bidding documents. The detailed scope work shall be as per ‘Scope of Work’, ‘Bid Specifi c Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC)’ and as per instruction of Engineer/Officer-In-Charge and other relevant Clauses of the tender documents. B. Estimated charges per man day mentioned in the bid document is inclusiv e of Overhead charges (@7% of minimum wages, inclusive of GST) (except

Contractor’s profit). The Overhead Charges caters to the expenses to be in curred by the Contractor towards procuring labour license, compliance of P F & ESI, operational cost of contract including bank charges towards CPG, c ost of manpower replacement as and when required, interest on the amoun t deducted from the running bills towards TDS, Security Deposit etc. and Co st of coordination / management of the labour engaged in the Contract etc. The above rate of Overhead Charges shall be fixed for entire duration of Co ntract. B. The bidder must be a ‘Class-I local supplier’ as defined under Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order as per bidding documents. Firms who are not ‘Class-I local supplier shall not b e eligible to bid. Presently, the local content requirement to categorize a supplier as ‘Cla ss-I local supplier’ is minimum 60%. The ‘Class-I local supplier’ shall give a self-certific ation in his bid in the given format, indicating the percentage of Local Content and certifying that the item offered meets the Local Content requirement for ‘Class –I local supplier’ and shall giv e details of the location(s) at which value addition is made. C. It is the Employer’s (POWERGRID’s) policy that requires the bidder to sign a declaratio n along with its bid about abiding by a ‘Code of Integrity for Public Procurement’. All bi dders are required to submit the same as a part of their technical bid. This policy is detai led in the bidding documents. D. Bid Specific Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC), Bid Forms and Qualification Requir ements against this tender package is enclosed as “Buyer uploaded ATC document” to this bid document. Bidder shall ensure to submit an acceptable Bid Security/EMD, mandatorily submit all d ocuments in support of Qualification Requirements and all the Bid Forms duly filled, sig ned, completed and submit the same as a part of their technical bid. E. Changes/ revision in Min wages as notified by govt., ESI/PF/Bonus % shall be revised a s per Govt norms. ESI: Where ESI is not applicable, medical insurance subject to ESI cei ling amount is applicable. Bonus Amount: Applicable as per provision of Bonus Act 197 0. F. GEOGRAPHICAL PRESENCE: The Bidder participating in the tender must have registere d office/ working site at North-East ern Region, India in at least one of the following sta tes: 1) Assam 2) Nagaland 3) Arunachal Pradesh 4) Manipur 5) Meghalaya 6) Mizoram 7) Tripura. Bidder is required to submit/upload valid and proper relevant documentary evidence in support of the same as a part of their technical bid, failing of which their bid shall stan d rejected. I. The premium for this policy will also be reimbursed to the c ontractor by POWERGRID, upon submission of relevant documents. J. Site information: It is imperative for bidder to satisfy himself completely of all local co nditions. In addition, the Bidder are expected to assess any problems relating to the m eans of access to the site, the accommodation they may require and its availability, be sides any other aspects including financial implication affecting the execution of the co ntract covered under these documents and specifications. A Bidder shall be deemed to have full knowledge of the site (whether he inspects or not) and no claim whatsoever o n this account at any stage shall be entertained. Submission of Bid by a Bidder implies that he has read this notice and all other Tender Documents and has made himself awa re of the scope and specifications of the work to be done and of conditions as well as o f local conditions and other factors which may have bearing on the execution of the wo rks. M. CPG/Security Deposit (SD): As a security towards satisfactory performance of the Cont ract, the successful Bidder, to whom the work is awarded, shall be required to furnish a Performance Guarantee in favour of the Owner within 28 days from the date of Contr act order. As an alternate option to CPG, pro-rata deduction ns @5% from the bills of the contrac tor, up-to 5% of the total contract value, shall be made towards Security Deposit in lieu of PBG; for which contractor shall confirm either of the options. In case of any amendment to the contract, the Contract price, as amended, shall be th e reference price for determining the value of Performance Guarantee/Security Deposit . The contractor shall accordingly, increase/decrease the Bank Guarantee/Security Dep osit value submitted towards Contract Performance Guarantee based on the amended c ontract value. Security Deposit shall be returned to the Contractor on successful compl etion of the w orks under the Contract after 90-Ninety days of end of the contract valid ity period. No interest shall be pay able to the Contractor against Security Deposit. N. Issuing Banks: The Bank Guarantee for Performance Security are to be provided by the Service Provider which should be issued either by a Public Sector Bank located in India, or a scheduled Indian Bank having pa id up capital (net of any accumulated losses) of R s. 1,000 million or above (the latest annual report of the Bank should support complian ce of capital adequacy ratio requirement) as per List of Banks enclosed.
